title: UPCS: Unbiased Persona Construction for Dialogue Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Automated sentence ranking using specialized bias-detecting models (Toxic-BERT and Unbiased-Toxic-RoBERTa) to calculate 'TB rank' and 'UTR rank'. Additionally, counting the number of biased sentences ('Bias Quantity') via GPT-3.5, and conducting a subjective pairwise human evaluation.

Evaluated collectively as part of general social and toxic bias metrics using Toxic-BERT, Unbiased-Toxic-RoBERTa, GPT-3.5 pairwise comparisons, and human evaluator assessments of the generated personas and dialogues.
